intro: Master Vornal is an elderly Darkspear jungle troll who resides in Sen'jin Village along the southern coast of Durotar. Despite his advancing years and extensive knowledge of alchemical concoctions, he stubbornly refuses to take on any apprentices.

p: Master Vornal is a fixture of Sen'jin Village, known for brewing potent draughts and spirits for his fellow Darkspear trolls. Though age is visibly catching up with him, Vornal remains intensely independent and stubbornly refuses to train any apprentices, preferring to mix his remedies and volatile mixtures entirely by his own hand.

Vornal occasionally tasks young adventurers with gathering harsh or peculiar ingredients from the surrounding lands, such as potent materials needed for solvents and mixtures. While he is willing to reward those who assist him, he keeps his precise methods and recipes guarded, treating his craft as a solitary pursuit.
